metadata.title: DoluMu — Istanbul transit crowding forecast
metadata.description: Hourly crowding forecasts for Istanbul metro, Metrobüs, bus, Marmaray and ferry lines. See how busy it will be before you ride and pick a quieter time.

common.notLive: Forecasts are built from historical ridership, the calendar and the weather forecast; they are not live counts.

details.title: How is this forecast made?
details.body: A machine-learning model predicts riders per hour from 2022–2024 hourly İstanbulkart taps, the calendar (holidays, school terms) and the weather forecast.
details.relative: Colours follow this line's own daily pattern: “Peak” means close to the day's busiest hours. These are forecasts, not live crowding.
details.confidenceLow: The capacity estimate has low confidence, so the occupancy figure is approximate.
details.confidenceStatic: Rail capacity comes from a fixed per-train capacity table.

sections.title: In short
body: DoluMu is an independent project offering hourly crowd forecasts and live line information for Istanbul public transport. This policy covers both the website (dolumu.app) and the iOS app.
There are no accounts; we never ask for your name, phone number or advertising identifier. We do not track you across apps or websites, show ads, or sell your data.

sections.title: What stays on your device
body: Favourites, recent searches, language and theme are kept only on your device (browser storage or your phone) and are never sent to us. You can delete them under Settings → Your data.

sections.title: Location
body: Your location is used only when you ask for it and allow it, never in the background.
On the website, nearby stations are worked out in your browser; your location is not sent to our servers.

In the iOS app, a position rounded to about 100 m is sent to our server to find nearby stations, stops and İstanbulkart top-up points. It is not stored; it may only appear in our hosting provider's short-lived technical request logs. Your exact position never leaves your phone.

sections.title: Notifications and alarms (iOS)
body: When you turn on a disruption alert or a bus alarm, your device is registered with an anonymous ID and a push token. The lines, stations and alarm details you choose (stop, line, direction, minutes before arrival) are stored with that registration.
Alarms last at most 60 minutes. Device registrations unused for 90 days are deleted. You can turn notifications off at any time in iOS Settings.

sections.title: Feedback
body: When you use Report a problem on the website or Send feedback in the app, the text, an optional line code and, if you give it, your email address are kept only to look into your report and reply. An email address is optional.

sections.title: Usage statistics
body: The website uses Vercel Web Analytics for aggregate page-view counts; it uses no cookies and does not identify you. The iOS app contains no analytics or crash-reporting tools.

sections.title: Service providers
body: The website and the app API run on Vercel; the forecast and notification server runs at Hetzner (Germany). Notifications are delivered through Expo and the Apple Push Notification service. Map tiles load from OpenFreeMap; these requests include your IP address and the area you are viewing.
Transit data is fetched by our servers from the open services of İBB, Metro İstanbul and İETT; no data about you is sent to them.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) and applicable law, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data. Write to the address below.
You can also remove your notification registration yourself: turn off all alerts or delete the app, and it is deleted within 90 days.

sections.title: Children
body: DoluMu does not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.

sections.title: Changes
body: If this policy changes, the current version is published on this page with its date.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Write to us with questions, bugs or wrong data in DoluMu.
support.reportDesc: Under Settings on the website and in the app

questions.a: No. Crowding is an hourly forecast made from past ridership, the calendar and the weather. Arrival times, vehicle positions and disruptions come live from İBB, Metro İstanbul and İETT.
Location permission is off, or you are outside Istanbul. On iPhone, turn it on in Settings → DoluMu → Location. You can browse lines and stops from anywhere through Map or Search.
Check that Settings → DoluMu → Notifications is on. Bus alarms last 60 minutes; disruption alerts arrive only when a new disruption starts.

questions.q: How do I delete my data?
questions.a: Favourites and searches: Settings → Your data. For your notification registration, turn off all alerts or delete the app; it is deleted within 90 days. You can also ask by email.
No. DoluMu is an independent project with no official connection to İBB, Metro İstanbul, İETT or other operators. It uses their open data services.
